defs.def: to make sth/sb clean using water and usually soap 洗；洗涤

ex.s: At least one thing proved truth: the color wouldn’t wash out.
ex.t: 至少有一件事被证明是真的：这颜色洗不掉。

ex.s: They share a front door and a washing machine, but Rita Whitehead has her own kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and living room on the ground floor.
ex.t: 他们共用一扇大门和一台洗衣机，但丽塔·怀特黑德在一楼有自己独立的厨房、浴室、卧室和起居室。

ex.s: Look at the way your face has been washed Look at the way your teeth have been brushed Look at the way your shoes have been cleaned You’d better do them again.
ex.t: 看看你的脸是怎么洗的，看看你的牙是怎么刷的，看看你的鞋是怎么擦的——你最好重做一遍。

ex.s: Part-time dish washer wanted at Italian restaurant.
ex.t: 意大利餐厅招聘兼职洗碗工。

defs.def: to make yourself clean using water and usually soap 洗澡；洗脸；洗手
to be able to be washed without losing colour or being damaged 衣服、织物等

ex.s: A feeling of helplessness washed over me as I saw the bus queue thinning out.
ex.t: 当我看到排队等巴士的人越来越少，一种无助感涌上心头。

ex.s: A feeling of helplessness washed over me as I saw the bus queue thinning out.

ex.s: （1分）My washing machine                 this week， so I have to wash my clothes by hand．（  ）
ex.t: （1分）我的洗衣机这周坏了，所以我不得不手洗衣服。（  ）

ex.s: The flat terraces catch the rainwater and prevent the soil from being washed away.
ex.t: 请找出每个单词后半部分中代表过去时态的部分。

defs.def: to flow or carry sth/sb in a particular direction 水

ex.s: The chemical washes off roads and goes into the ground.
ex.t: 在那里它可以污染饮用水、损害植物、侵蚀土壤。

defs.def: to clean sth large or a surface with a lot of water 冲洗，冲刷（大件物品或表面）

ex.s: She went right into the shower to washing it, but it was no use.
ex.t: 她马上去淋浴冲洗，但没有用。

ex.s: Yes, and how many years can a mountain exist Before it’s wash(ed) to the sea?
ex.t: 是的，一座山能存在多少年，才被（冲刷）入海？

defs.def: to drink sth after, or at the same time as, eating sth 配着食物喝（饮料）
to wash the inside of sth to remove dirt, etc. 洗净，清洗（某物的内部）

ex.s: The terraces are cleverly designed, and can wash away the shallow soil.
ex.t: 露台设计巧妙，可以冲走浅层土壤。

defs.def: to remove a substance from sth by washing 把 … 洗掉
to make a game, an event, etc. end early or prevent it from starting 雨
to suddenly affect sb strongly, so that they are not aware of anything else 感觉
to happen to or around sb without affecting them （周围发生的事情）对 … 无多大影响
to wash plates, glasses, etc. after a meal 洗刷饭后的杯盘等
to wash your face and hands 洗脸和手
to wash dishes after a meal 洗刷（吃饭用过的盘子等）
to carry sth onto land 水
an act of cleaning sb/sth using water and usually soap 洗；洗涤；清洗；洗刷

ex.s: Volunteers will wash, cut, and freeze or dry them for use in meals down the road.
ex.t: 志愿者们会将它们清洗、切块、冷冻或干燥，以便日后用于餐食中。

ex.s: We had to have a bit of a production line going, making up “tiger milk”, washing baby bottles, and cleaning the floors.
ex.t: 当斑点和条纹四个月大时，它们学会了开门和跳围栏，我们知道真的是时候送它们走了。

defs.def: an area of water that has waves and is moving a lot, especially after a boat has moved through it; the sound made by this （尤指船过后划出的）水流，波浪；波浪拍打声
a thin layer of a liquid, especially paint, that is put on a surface 薄涂层（尤指涂料）
a liquid containing soap, used for cleaning your skin 肥皂液
